results.name: Playstation 5 Dualsense
results.description:
Ps5 dualsense controller modeled in Cinema 4d and textured in substane painter. 

This is my first model on sketchfab, so if there are some minor mistakes than I am quite sorry. I made this mdoel after discovering a ps5 bump texture, https://www.sharetextures.com/textures/abstract/ps5_controller_texture/, so I gave it a shot and the model turned out quite well.
I had no accurate blueprints or even an actual controller on hand, so some minor imperfections are to be expected but overall a good model.
Hope you like it.
